The version and release-date figures in the IaC tools comparison table were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
The IaC tools pricing-at-a-glance table is based on published pricing as of September 2026.
env zero is the current name of the company/product formerly known as env0, and Spacelift and env zero are managed CI/CD layers frequently compared against core IaC tools like Terraform and Pulumi.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than by seats or resources.
Spacelift's top-end pricing tier is quote-based.
env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or per environment.
The Pulumi GitHub repository (pulumi/pulumi) has roughly 25.7k (about 25,700) GitHub stars as of 2026-09-21.
The Terraform GitHub repository (hashicorp/terraform) has roughly 49.7k (about 49,700) GitHub stars as of 2026-09-21.
The AWS CDK GitHub repository (aws/aws-cdk) has roughly 12.9k (about 12,900) GitHub stars as of 2026-09-21.
The Azure Bicep GitHub repository (Azure/bicep) has roughly 3.6k GitHub stars as of 2026-09-21.
The Kubernetes GitHub repository (kubernetes/kubernetes) has roughly 127.9k (about 127,900) GitHub stars as of 2026-09-21.
The Crossplane GitHub repository (crossplane/crossplane) has roughly 12.1k (about 12,100) GitHub stars as of 2026-09-21.
The OpenTofu GitHub repository (opentofu/opentofu) has roughly 30.2k (about 30,200) GitHub stars as of 2026-09-21.
Among dedicated IaC tools, Terraform is the most-starred on GitHub, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane in that order; Kubernetes has more stars than all of them.
Kubernetes is the de facto container orchestration standard.
Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption.
Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure management, respectively.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager is fully turned down on June 30, 2027 for any workloads still migrating.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user, with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud's Essentials plan starts at $40/month, including 40 credits and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Pro plan starts at $400/month, including 400 credits and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Enterprise plan is custom, contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run.
HCP Terraform beyond the free tier uses per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Self-hosted Terraform Enterprise is available at custom pricing for larger organizations.
The Pulumi Cloud and HCP Terraform pricing figures reflect published pricing checked on 2026-09-21.
